story.title: Twenty years of carrying the goods that keep Zambia moving.
story.lead: Panafrica Distributors Limited is a Zambian-registered, large-scale distributor of fast-moving consumer goods — not a conventional wholesaler, but a specialist in the last mile.
story.body: We operate out of a 3,000 m² warehouse and office facility at Plot 20108, Mumbwa Road, Chinika Area, Lusaka, supported by depots in Monze and Livingstone. Our model is Direct Store Delivery: our own people, in our own vehicles, placing and replenishing stock on the shelf where it actually sells.
story.imageAlt: A deep warehouse aisle at Panafrica Distributors, shelving stacked with packaged fast-moving consumer goods under overhead lights.

network.title: Three depots. Three provinces. One last mile.
network.body: From Lusaka we serve the Lusaka and Western Province markets. Monze and Livingstone carry the Southern Province, with weekly routes into the towns and townships that national chains rarely reach.
network.imageAlt: Laden distribution trucks moving along a multi-lane highway at speed.

map.title: Where the last mile reaches
map.intro: An indicative map of the network. Each route line is drawn hub by hub — Lusaka west to Mongu, and south through Monze and Choma to Livingstone and the Kazungula border.
map.ariaLabel: Indicative map of Zambia showing Panafrica Distributors depots at Lusaka, Monze and Livingstone and their distribution routes.

legend.text: Mazabuka, Choma, Kalomo, Zimba, Kazungula, Mamba, Mumbwa, Mungu, Kafue, Siavonga, Chirundu and Mongu.

brands.title: Trusted to carry names that people already know.
brands.intro: Panafrica Distributors represents its principals exclusively across its territories, servicing modern trade, wholesalers, supermarkets, large and small-scale retailers, bars, clubs, restaurants and hotels.
brands.note: Photography is representative of each product category and does not depict the principals’ own packaging.

items.name: British American Tobacco
items.desc: The group’s deepest franchise, served by a dedicated field and delivery team working a trade customer base of roughly 1,950 outlets on tight, high-frequency cycles.
items.caption: Tobacco & nicotine
items.imageAlt: Cured tobacco leaves in a processing tray.

items.name: Nestlé South Africa
items.desc: The food and beverage lines that restock fastest — everyday pantry and beverage brands that keep a route profitable and a shelf full between deliveries.
items.caption: Food & beverage
items.imageAlt: Beverage bottles and food packaging arranged on a counter.

items.name: Lion Match Products
items.desc: Matches and household essentials with deep, repeat demand: low ticket, high frequency, sold in every outlet type from supermarket to street kiosk.
items.caption: Household & matches
items.imageAlt: Matches and small household goods stacked in a store.

items.name: Colgate-Palmolive Zambia
items.desc: Oral and personal care placed and replenished shelf by shelf, with the merchandising discipline and category control that personal care demands.
items.caption: Personal & oral care

items.name: Mansa Sugar
items.desc: Sugar and staples moved in bulk to wholesalers, supermarkets and large-scale retailers along the Lusaka and Southern Province corridors.
items.caption: Sugar & staples

items.name: Duncan Gilbey & Matheson
items.desc: Spirits and beverages supplied to the on-trade — bars, clubs, restaurants and hotels — alongside the off-trade liquor and grocery channel.
items.caption: Spirits & beverages
items.imageAlt: Spirits and beverage bottles on a bar counter.

people.name: Hon. Suresh M. Desai
people.bio: Forty years in retail, wholesale and last-mile distribution. A former Member of Parliament and minister, holding portfolios including Energy and Water Development, Works and Supply, and Agriculture.

people.name: Rajen Desai
people.bio: An MBA from the University of Derby (UK) and more than twelve years of hands-on last-mile distribution experience across the group’s territories.

people.name: Nainan Mathews
people.bio: An honours degree in agriculture with thirty-six years of experience — thirteen years in agricultural distribution and sixteen years in FMCG marketing.

people.name: Thirumula Chary
people.bio: An MBA in finance with fourteen years in banking and eight years leading management information systems.

people.name: Sanjay Datta
people.bio: An MA in economics and B.Com (Meerut University) with over thirty years in sales and marketing, product launches and distributor network development.

people.name: Malawo Siakufweba
people.bio: Eleven years in accounting across transport, manufacturing and distribution. Holds the ATD accounting diploma and is pursuing ZICA certification.

people.name: Greyson Foloshi
people.bio: A business administration graduate with several years across sales, marketing and distribution, including service with British American Tobacco.

people.name: Ismail Mulla
people.bio: Thirty-five years of experience in sales and marketing, running wholesale distribution across the group’s network.
